items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I asked you, Mr. Barton, if he belonged to any of the organizations...

ctx.x: That was a French day. 14th of July.
I asked you, Mr. Barton, if he belonged to any of the organizations, you know, the fraternal clubs.
That he played for? No, that he belonged to any himself. Yeah, when you belonged to those clubs that you used to play for, honey, Tulane, what else you belonged to?
